name: alphabetical-function-cards
goal: Function cards sort by their displayed callable name by default and open through the code link without a duplicate arrow

evidence: Default function ordering follows the callable name displayed in its code. Cards expose one code link, no arrow, and retain branch/commit navigation.

Shared collection tests ordered hidden titles, and viewport card cases required the duplicate arrow. Extend the same collection matrix with conflicting titles/callables and require one keyboard-reachable code link.
